_comment: Hand-written metadata for Latvia sources, used to build the find_data map. English→Latvian terms live in lv.SYNONYMS; `headline` marks the most-asked tables (see eu/hints.json).

sources.CSB: Latvia only; ~1,700 tables with regional detail down to municipality (novads) and city; English titles

CSB.POP/IR/IRS/IRS010: population inhabitants people total key figures births deaths marriages migration annual
CSB.POP/IR/IRD/IRD081: population inhabitants age sex gender region municipality city
CSB.POP/IR/IRV/IRV020: population inhabitants age sex citizenship nationality
CSB.POP/NN/NNR/NNR020: poverty at risk of poverty rate
CSB.EMP/NBBA/NBBB/NBB160c: unemployment rate unemployed persons jobless labour force survey quarterly
CSB.EMP/NBBA/NBBB/NBL290c: unemployment rate employment rate education long-term
CSB.EMP/NBBA/NBBB/NBA031: unemployment rate employment rate activity region
CSB.EMP/NBBA/NVA/NVA020m: registered unemployed unemployment employment agency region monthly
CSB.EMP/DS/DSV/DSV010c: wages salaries average monthly earnings pay quarterly
CSB.VEK/PC/PCI/PCI021m: inflation consumer prices cpi price index commodity groups monthly
CSB.VEK/PC/PCI/PCI030m: inflation consumer prices cpi price index since 1990
CSB.VEK/PC/PCS/PCS011m: inflation harmonised consumer prices hicp commodity groups monthly
CSB.VEK/IK/IKP/IKP010: gdp gross domestic product per capita economy annual
